author: Legoche
body:
Hey! Tazz has asked me to edit SuppyTDM for the next tournament and I would like to ask you all for feedback. If you haven't played the map, don't respond. Actually give feedback on what needs adding or removing, anything like "remove the map" isn't feedback, state why you want it removing if you so hate my map.

To Do:
  • Make the map bigger in general - To make it 8v8
  • Scoreboxes - 2 points depending on positions.
  • Fix lag issues with glass roof - remove for easy spectating.
  • Prevent spawn camping - multiple exits out of spawn? one way drop down?
  • Longer Spawn Timer
  • Improve Aesthetics

replies.body:
Remove the outer walls and separate the platforms a bit. Basically make the map aerial with void rather than closed off.

Add walls to the entrances to the tunnel to make it more secure for an attacking team.

Remove the wall in front of spawn with the webs.

Add a wall that would act as a barrier between the drop from spawn and the entrance of the tunnel.

Make the tunnel exposed to void.

Make the archer and top positions more defensible.

Change the Gapple spawner to insta health I.

Remove the glass on top.

Remove fall damage.
